label: History
value: Billina traveled alongside Dorothy Gale and Tiktok
unit: Billina traveled alongside Dorothy Gale and Tiktok to the Land of Ev, where she visited the palace of Princess Langwidere. When Nanda the maid attempted to stop her from entering, Billina flew at her face to gain entry alongside Dorothy. Later, while locked in a chicken house by the Princess, Billina engaged in a violent physical fight with a local speckled rooster to prevent him from dominating her, emerging victorious before being set free by Dorothy and Ozma. She accompanied the royal party on their expedition to the Nome King's underground realm. While sleeping beneath the Nome King's throne, she secretly overheard the monarch reveal to his Steward that the Queen of Ev and her children had been transformed into royal purple ornaments. Leveraging this secret knowledge, she explored the underground palace, touched the purple ornaments while saying the magic word 'Ev', and successfully restored the Queen and her nine children to their natural human forms. While inspecting the palace's green ornaments, she also pounced on a transformed Ozma in emerald grasshopper form, though she quickly dropped her upon realizing she was hard and lifeless.

label: History
value: The Cowardly Lion encountered Dorothy Gale.
unit: The Cowardly Lion encountered Dorothy Gale, the Scarecrow, the Tin Woodman, and Toto on their journey toward the Emerald City. Admitting his deep unhappiness over his lack of bravery, he decided to join their party in hopes that the Great Oz would grant him courage. Along the way, he scared off people who approached them and traveled alongside Dorothy to protect her from wild beasts. When passing through a deadly poppy field, he fell asleep from the flowers' fragrance, but was saved by the field mice, for which he expressed deep gratitude. Upon reaching the Emerald City, he met with Oz, who provided him a potion from a green bottle in a green-gold dish; after drinking it, he felt filled with courage. Later, he joined Dorothy and her companions on further adventures in the Land of Oz.

label: History
value: Dorothy arrived in the Land of Oz
unit: Dorothy arrived in the Land of Oz from Kansas after being carried by a cyclone. Along her journey, she befriended the Scarecrow, whom she picked up whenever he stumbled on the uneven yellow brick road, as well as the Tin Woodman, the Cowardly Lion, and Toto. While seeking a way back to Kansas from the Wizard of Oz, she waited four days in the Emerald City before Oz proposed building a hot-air balloon. She assisted Oz by sewing together strips of green silk to create the balloon bag. Later, Dorothy experienced further adventures alongside companions including Tiktok, the Yellow Hen Billina, and the Hungry Tiger. Upon reuniting with her old friends in the Land of Ev, she wound up Tiktok, joyfully embraced the Scarecrow, Tin Woodman, and Cowardly Lion, rescued Billina from a fight in the chicken house, and joined Princess Ozma in a grand gathering.

label: History
value: Evardo was born.
unit: Evardo was born the eldest prince of the Land of Ev. He and his family were transformed into purple ornaments and held captive in the Nome King's underground palace. Billina, the yellow hen, discovered his transformation among the purple ornaments in the palace and broke the enchantment, restoring him to his true form alongside his mother and siblings. After returning to the royal palace in Ev, his mother presented him to the gathered crowd as King Evardo Fifteenth. He was crowned with a ruby-set gold crown, draped in an ermine robe, and acknowledged by his subjects, including the Wheelers. Later that evening, he presented Billina with a necklace of pearls and sapphires to express his esteem and gratitude for restoring his family.

label: History
value: Prince Evring was sold to the Nome King.
unit: Along with his mother and siblings, Prince Evring was sold to the Nome King by his father, after which he lost all memory of his past while held under enchantment. He was transformed into an ornament in the shape of a purple kitten sitting on a mantelpiece in the underground palace. When Dorothy Gale touched his image and spoke the magical word 'Ev' during her guessing attempts, Evring was restored to his true form as a fair-haired boy. Unaware of his former state as a kitten, he proudly announced his identity as a Prince of Ev and willingly accompanied Dorothy through the palace as she attempted to rescue the rest of his family. After leaving the palace, he was reunited with his mother, the Queen of Ev, and his nine brothers and sisters after they were freed from their enchantments.

unit: Along with his mother and siblings, Prince Evring was sold to the Nome King by his father, after which he lost all memory of his past while held under enchantment. He was transformed into an ornament in the shape of a purple kitten sitting on a mantelpiece in the underground palace. When Dorothy Gale touched his image and spoke the magical word 'Ev' during her guessing attempts, Evring was restored to his true form as a fair-haired boy. Unaware of his former state as a kitten, he proudly announced his identity as a Prince of Ev and willingly accompanied Dorothy through the palace as she attempted to rescue the rest of his family. After leaving the palace, he was reunited with his mother, the Queen of Ev, and his nine brothers and sisters after they were freed from their enchantments.

label: History
value: Glinda led an army
unit: Glinda led an army to the Emerald City to demand the surrender of old Mombi from Queen Jinjur. When Jinjur's guards delivered a disguised Jellia Jamb instead of Mombi, Glinda questioned the girl and quickly detected the deception, using her magical abilities to break the enchantment and restore Jellia's natural shape. Enraged by the trickery, Glinda negotiated terms with Jinjur to enter the city and search for Mombi directly, bringing along the Scarecrow, the Tin Woodman, Jack Pumpkinhead, the Woggle-Bug, and Tip, for whom she had taken a strong liking. Though Mombi attempted to evade capture by transforming into a red rose, Glinda eventually secured her and brought her to her tent for interrogation. Glinda presented Mombi with a choice between death and the loss of her magical powers, enforcing honesty using a magical white pearl that turned black whenever a lie was told. Through this interrogation, Glinda compelled Mombi to reveal that she had enchanted Princess Ozma, the rightful ruler of the Emerald City, by transforming her into the boy Tip. Glinda gently comforted Tip and explained his true identity as a Princess born to rule.

unit: Glinda led an army to the Emerald City to demand the surrender of old Mombi from Queen Jinjur. When Jinjur's guards delivered a disguised Jellia Jamb instead of Mombi, Glinda questioned the girl and quickly detected the deception, using her magical abilities to break the enchantment and restore Jellia's natural shape. Enraged by the trickery, Glinda negotiated terms with Jinjur to enter the city and search for Mombi directly, bringing along the Scarecrow, the Tin Woodman, Jack Pumpkinhead, the Woggle-Bug, and Tip, for whom she had taken a strong liking. Though Mombi attempted to evade capture by transforming into a red rose, Glinda eventually secured her and brought her to her tent for interrogation. Glinda presented Mombi with a choice between death and the loss of her magical powers, enforcing honesty using a magical white pearl that turned black whenever a lie was told. Through this interrogation, Glinda compelled Mombi to reveal that she had enchanted Princess Ozma, the rightful ruler of the Emerald City, by transforming her into the boy Tip. Glinda gently comforted Tip and explained his true identity as a Princess born to rule.

He views himself as a bad tiger because he refuses to act as cruelly and ferociously as his nature dictates. His appetite causes him to view creatures like Billina greedily, though his principles and social politeness keep his desires in check.

label: History
value: The Hungry Tiger was born with an unquenchable hunger.
unit: Born with an unquenchable hunger, the Hungry Tiger left his native forest because his strong conscience prevented him from engaging in the cruel and ferocious behavior typical of tigers. He joined the Cowardly Lion, becoming his close friend, and traveled hitched beside him to Princess Ozma's chariot. Upon meeting Dorothy Gale outside the palace drawing-room, he introduced himself, discussed his appetite for living creatures and fat babies, and explained why his conscience prevented him from harming them. When Dorothy introduced him to her yellow hen, Billina, the Tiger looked at the hen greedily and admitted she made his mouth water, but agreed not to eat her because she was Dorothy's friend and it would be wrong.

label: History
value: Jack is constructed by Tip.
unit: After being constructed by Tip to frighten Mombi, Jack is brought to life when Mombi applies the Powder of Life to him. He sets off with Tip toward the Emerald City, riding on the back of the animated Saw-Horse and crossing a swift river along the way. Upon arriving at the Emerald City, he is escorted to the palace by the Soldier with the Green Whiskers to meet His Majesty the Scarecrow. During their first meeting, Jack and the Scarecrow struggle to understand one another until they establish communication, after which Jack becomes a supportive companion to the Scarecrow and his allies through their subsequent journeys and escapes.

label: History
value: General Jinjur organized a secret Army of Revolt.
unit: General Jinjur organized a secret Army of Revolt consisting entirely of young women from across the Land of Oz with the intention of overthrowing male rule in the Emerald City. Along the road to the capital, she encountered Tip, shared her lunch with him, and explained her plan to seize the city's wealth and gems for her army. Jinjur led her forces to conquer the Emerald City, usurped the throne from the Scarecrow, and declared herself Queen. label: History
value: Following the loss of the royal family of Ev to the Nome King, Princess Langwidere took up residence in a section of the royal palace.
unit: Following the loss of the royal family of Ev to the Nome King, Princess Langwidere took up residence in a section of the royal palace. Lacking a formal monarch to govern the realm, she took control of as much money from the royal treasury as she could spend. She designed her living spaces to guard her privacy and indulge her vanity, including using a trick with the palace's wings to confound visitors and lining her sitting room with mirrors to admire her various heads. When Dorothy Gale, Tiktok, and Billina arrived at her palace seeking an audience, Langwidere retired to her cabinet to put on Head No. 17 to ensure she would not be outshone in beauty by her new guest.

label: History
value: Mombi lived in the Gillikin Country.
unit: Mombi lived in the Gillikin Country as a feared sorceress, raising a boy named Tip from childhood after receiving the infant Princess Ozma from the Wizard of Oz. In exchange for concealing the infant by enchanting her into a boy, the Wizard taught Mombi his magical tricks. Later, after Tip escaped her care, Mombi allied with General Jinjur during the usurpation of the Emerald City. When Glinda the Sorceress marched upon the city to demand Mombi's surrender, Mombi attempted multiple magical deceptions, first disguising Jellia Jamb to look like herself and later turning herself into a red rose in the palace garden. Her disguise as a rose was unintentionally carried out of the city by the Tin Woodman, leading to her discovery. Confronted by Glinda and threatened with death or the loss of her magical powers, Mombi confessed the truth that she had transformed Princess Ozma into Tip.

unit: The Nome King initially presents a merry, jolly, and soft-spoken demeanour, resembling Santa Claus and shaking with laughter like a bowl full of jelly. He claims to be kind-hearted and susceptible to coaxing and wheedling rather than threats. However, he is cunning and deceitful, luring visitors into dangerous guessing games to turn them into decorative ornaments for his palace. When thwarted or opposed, his merry face distorts with intense rage.

label: History
value: The Nome King holds the Queen of Ev captive in his subterranean palace.
unit: The Nome King holds the Queen of Ev and her ten children captive in his subterranean palace, having enchanted them into ornaments. When Princess Ozma of Oz and her companions travel to his underground realm to demand their release, he initially ignores requests until Dorothy Gale addresses him. He receives them in a domed cavern upon a jeweled rock throne, appearing jolly and smoking a pipe. Refusing to surrender his captives outright, he demonstrates his vast army of mail-clad Nome warriors to prove his power. He then proposes a bargain: Ozma and her followers may individually enter his palace to guess which objects are the transformed royal family, but anyone who fails will themselves be enchanted into bric-a-brac. After Ozma and the Tin Woodman fail their attempts and are turned into ornaments, he continues forcing the remaining travelers and officers to enter the palace one by one. His face distorts with terrible rage when his forces assemble in the cavern.

label: History
value: Ozma was born as the only child of the former Ruler of Oz
unit: Ozma was born as the only child of the former Ruler of Oz, but as a baby she was stolen by a wicked witch and magically transformed into a boy. She grew up unaware of her true identity until a kind sorceress restored her to her natural form. After experiencing many adventures alongside companions including a pumpkin-headed man, an educated Woggle-Bug, and a magical Sawhorse, she regained her father's throne as ruler of Oz. Upon learning of the plight of the royal family of Ev, she organized an expedition to rescue them, accompanied by her brave followers as well as the Cowardly Lion and Hungry Tiger. Their journey led them to the underground domain of the Nome King, where Ozma refused to demean her royal dignity by pleading with the monarch. Confronted with the Nome King's formidable army, she agreed to negotiate peacefully and accepted his offer to enter his palace alone to attempt to break the enchantments on the royal family of Ev, accepting the personal risk of enchantment if she failed.

label: History
value: The Saw-Horse is brought to life.
unit: The Saw-Horse is brought to life by Tip using magical powder. Upon animating, it circles around in confusion because it lacks a neck to view its own body, eventually bumping into Jack Pumpkinhead and stepping on Tip's foot. Realizing the creature lacks hearing, Tip carves bark ears and attaches them to its head; the sudden acquisition of hearing startles the horse into a frantic run until it tumbles into a gopher hole. After Tip sets it upright and teaches it basic commands like 'whoa' and 'trot', a post is hammered into its back so Jack Pumpkinhead can ride without wearing out his joints.

unit: The Saw-Horse is brought to life by Tip using magical powder. Upon animating, it circles around in confusion because it lacks a neck to view its own body, eventually bumping into Jack Pumpkinhead and stepping on Tip's foot. Realizing the creature lacks hearing, Tip carves bark ears and attaches them to its head; the sudden acquisition of hearing startles the horse into a frantic run until it tumbles into a gopher hole. After Tip sets it upright and teaches it basic commands like 'whoa' and 'trot', a post is hammered into its back so Jack Pumpkinhead can ride without wearing out his joints.

label: History
value: The Saw-Horse suffers a broken leg
unit: During the group's journey to the Emerald City, the Saw-Horse suffers a broken leg when it stumbles into a rabbit hole. The Tin Woodman crafts a new leg from Jack Pumpkinhead's donated limb, but since the replacement is slightly too long, the steed limps until the Tin Woodman chops it down to size. The Saw-Horse continues to serve as a reliable mount and companion through various trials across Oz.

label: Appearance
value: The Scarecrow is made entirely of straw.
unit: The Scarecrow is made entirely of straw, dressed in a suit of faded blue clothes. His head is a small sack stuffed with straw on which facial features are rudely painted, and wisps of straw stick out from his coat, neck, and boot-tops. He wears padded cotton gloves on his hands, and when ruling, he wore a heavy golden crown set thick with sparkling jewels that caused his brow to sag in wrinkles.

label: History
value: The Scarecrow was originally created in the Land of Oz.
unit: The Scarecrow was originally created in the Land of Oz and placed on a pole in a cornfield until he met Dorothy Gale. Joining Dorothy on her journey along the yellow brick road to seek brains from the Great Oz, he traveled alongside her and helped recruit the Tin Woodman. After defeating the Wicked Witch of the West, he received his requested brains from the Wizard, who appointed him as the ruler of the Emerald City. As King, he governed the city until General Jinjur led an all-female revolt that drove him from the throne. Escaping with allies like Tip and Jack Pumpkinhead, he set out to find his old comrade, the Tin Woodman, and seek assistance from Glinda the Good. During their journey across Oz, he helped guide the group using the sun and worked to repair their companions along the way.

Joining Dorothy on her journey along the yellow brick road to seek brains from the Great Oz, he traveled alongside her and helped recruit the Tin Woodman. After defeating the Wicked Witch of the West, he received his requested brains from the Wizard, who appointed him as the ruler of the Emerald City. As King, he governed the city until General Jinjur led an all-female revolt that drove him from the throne. Escaping with allies like Tip and Jack Pumpkinhead, he set out to find his old comrade, the Tin Woodman, and seek assistance from Glinda the Good. During their journey across Oz, he helped guide the group using the sun and worked to repair their companions along the way.

label: History
value: Tiktok was created by Smith & Tinker.
unit: Tiktok was created by the inventors Smith & Tinker in the Land of Ev and sold to King Ev-oldo, who eventually locked him inside a rock cavern. Dorothy Gale discovered him, unfastened his operating instructions card, and wound his three clockworks for thought, speech, and action. Upon being restored to functionality, Tiktok declared himself Dorothy's faithful follower and servant. He guided and protected Dorothy and the yellow hen Billina through Ev, defending them against the mischievous Wheelers using a tin dinner-pail and capturing their leader to force their submission. He then led the group to the royal palace in Ev to seek an audience with Princess Langwidere.

label: History
value: Tiktok met Princess Ozma
unit: After Princess Langwidere imprisoned Dorothy, Tiktok met Princess Ozma and her royal party from Oz. He accompanied Ozma's expedition across the desert to the Underground World of the Nome King to rescue the royal family of Ev. During the journey, he timed his movements precisely to pass safely under the hammer of the Iron Giant. At the Nome King's entrance, Tiktok advised Ozma on diplomacy, suggesting entreaty when royal commands failed. He attempted the Nome King's guessing game in the palace, but was transformed into a gold ornament after running down and failing. Following his restoration by Billina, he helped free his allies and return to Oz. At the conclusion of their adventures, Dorothy left Tiktok in the Land of Oz under the care and keeping of Princess Ozma.

unit: After Princess Langwidere imprisoned Dorothy, Tiktok met Princess Ozma and her royal party from Oz. He accompanied Ozma's expedition across the desert to the Underground World of the Nome King to rescue the royal family of Ev. During the journey, he timed his movements precisely to pass safely under the hammer of the Iron Giant. At the Nome King's entrance, Tiktok advised Ozma on diplomacy, suggesting entreaty when royal commands failed. He attempted the Nome King's guessing game in the palace, but was transformed into a gold ornament after running down and failing. Following his restoration by Billina, he helped free his allies and return to Oz. At the conclusion of their adventures, Dorothy left Tiktok in the Land of Oz under the care and keeping of Princess Ozma.

label: History
value: The Tin Woodman aided Dorothy Gale in melting the Wicked Witch.
unit: After aiding Dorothy Gale in melting the Wicked Witch, the Tin Woodman confronted the Wizard of Oz in the Throne Room, demanding the fulfillment of his promise. Upon discovering that Oz was a humbug, he worried about obtaining a heart, but the Wizard eventually placed a valued organ inside his chest. He was later chosen by the Winkies to be their Emperor and had his body nickel-plated. When the Scarecrow arrived at his castle following the Army of Revolt's uprising in the Emerald City, the Tin Woodman joyfully embraced his friend and pledged to help him recapture his throne. Trapped inside the palace, he smashed a mahogany center-table with his axe to make a new leg for Jack Pumpkinhead and agreed to build a flying machine on the roof so the group could escape by air.

label: History
value: Tip constructed a tall wooden man.
unit: Tip constructed a tall wooden man with a pumpkin head named Jack Pumpkinhead, using pieces chopped from the forest and clothes retrieved from Mombi's chest. Later, while traveling toward the Emerald City to rejoin Jack Pumpkinhead and the Saw-Horse, Tip ran out of food and encountered General Jinjur by the roadside. He shared her luncheon and carried her basket while learning about the secret Army of Revolt and their plan to conquer the Emerald City. After the creation of the Gump, Tip helped direct the flying creature to transport his party to the South Country to consult Glinda the Good. When a wild Lion bounded out and struck the Scarecrow and Tin Woodman, Toto fearlessly ran barking toward the beast to face him, prompting Dorothy to step in and protect Toto. After the Lion admitted his cowardice and joined their party, Toto continued on the journey toward the Emerald City. Along the way, he shared meals with Dorothy and slept beside her at night while the Lion guarded her door. Upon arriving at the high green wall of the Emerald City, Toto entered through the emerald-studded gate with the rest of the group to seek an audience with the Great Oz.

label: History
value: Uncle Henry lived on the flat Kansas prairies.
unit: Uncle Henry lived on the flat Kansas prairies in a tiny one-room house, working hard from morning to night to maintain his farm. When a severe cyclone approached his home, he hurried off to tend to his livestock while his family sought shelter. The cyclone swept the farmhouse away with Dorothy inside, separating her from her family. Following the event, Uncle Henry's health declined, leading him to travel to Sydney, Australia to rest. While sitting alone in a room in Sydney smoking his briar pipe, he was observed through Ozma's Magic Picture by Dorothy, who noticed his white hair and wasted appearance and decided to use magic to travel to Australia to care for him.

label: History
value: The Wicked Witch of the West rules the western country of the Winkies.
unit: The Wicked Witch of the West rules the western country of the Winkies from her castle. Spotting Dorothy Gale and her companions traveling through her land with her telescopic single eye, she blows a silver whistle to command a pack of forty great wolves to tear them to pieces, but the Tin Woodman slays them all. The next morning, upon seeing her dead wolves, she blows her whistle twice to summon a flock of wild crows to peck out their eyes, though they too are defeated. Eventually, she dons the Golden Cap from her cupboard to invoke its magical incantation for her third and final time, summoning the Winged Monkeys. She commands them to destroy the Tin Woodman and the Scarecrow, capture and tie up the Cowardly Lion, and bring Dorothy to her castle. Because Dorothy is protected by the mark of the Good Witch's kiss, the Witch cannot harm her directly, so she forces Dorothy to clean pots and kettles in her kitchen as a slave.

label: History
value: The Wizard of Oz established his seat of power in the Emerald City.
unit: The Wizard of Oz established his seat of power in the Emerald City, residing in the great Throne Room of his palace without showing his true face to the public. When Dorothy Gale and her companions arrived at the city seeking his help, he granted them individual audiences, assuming a different illusionary form for each traveler—appearing as a Head to Dorothy, a lovely Lady to the Scarecrow, a woolly five-eyed Beast to the Tin Woodman, and a glowing Ball of Fire to the Cowardly Lion. In each instance, he refused to grant their wishes until they proved their worth by destroying the Wicked Witch of the West. Following the Witch's defeat, his trickery was confronted. Eventually preparing to leave the Land of Oz, he constructed a large silk hot-air balloon. Before a gathered crowd of citizens, he proclaimed the Scarecrow as the new ruler of the city in his absence. As he boarded the basket, the balloon prematurely snapped its ropes and carried him high into the sky without Dorothy, leaving the citizens of the Emerald City to grieve his departure while remembering him with love.

value: The Woggle-Bug is polite.

label: History
value: Woggle-Bug was born as an ordinary bug in the Land of Oz.
unit: Born as an ordinary bug in the Land of Oz, the Woggle-Bug crept into a country schoolhouse to escape the cold and settled in a hearth nest. He lived there for three years, attentively listening to the discourses of Professor Nowitall and acquiring a immense fund of knowledge. One day, Professor Nowitall captured him and projected him onto a screen using a magnifying instrument to show his pupils. When the Woggle-Bug stood up and bowed politely, two startled schoolgirls fell out of the window, prompting the professor to rush out and giving the insect a chance to escape. He later encountered Tip, the Scarecrow, the Tin Woodman, Jack Pumpkinhead, and the Saw-Horse, introducing himself and sharing his life story. When Queen Jinjur's forces trapped the party in the palace, he worried about being turned into goulash or soup, though he insensitively suggested eating Jack Pumpkinhead's head to survive. Following the restoration of peace, he remained in the Emerald City and attempted to educate Jack Pumpkinhead, though the effort was eventually abandoned.
